en.headline: Work week set for mainly cloudy days with showers and milder heat
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects a few showers and isolated thunderstorms early in the week, with temperatures generally between 27 and 31 degrees and sunny intervals at times.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the coming work week will bring mainly cloudy conditions with a few showers, after a very hot and dry Sunday. An anticyclone aloft is giving way to upper-air disturbances and a gradual strengthening of the northeast monsoon mid-week.

Monday is forecast to be mainly cloudy with a few showers and isolated thunderstorms, plus sunny intervals during the day. Temperatures will range from 27 to 31 degrees Celsius, with relative humidity between 70 and 95 per cent. Northeast winds of force 2 to 3 are expected.
Tuesday looks similar, with mainly cloudy skies, a few showers and sunny intervals. Winds will be light at first, becoming east force 3 to 4. The temperature range remains 27 to 31 degrees.

From Wednesday the weather should improve somewhat, with sunny periods and only isolated showers under east force 4 winds. Thursday is expected to be mainly fine, though cloudy periods may appear in the morning and at night. Friday returns to mainly cloudy skies with isolated showers and sunny periods during the day.

The Observatory noted that Tropical Cyclone Dujuan is moving across the seas south of Japan and is not expected to affect Hong Kong directly. Residents were advised to stay updated on the latest forecasts as showers can be localised.

zh.headline: 未來工作天大致多雲有驟雨 氣溫回落至27至31度
zh.dek: 天文台預料本週初有幾陣驟雨及局部雷暴，日間短暫有陽光，氣溫普遍介乎27至31度，星期三起天色漸轉好。
body: 香港天文台表示，繼周日酷熱乾燥後，未來工作天大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨。高空反氣旋影響減弱，同時受高空擾動影響，東北季候風預料在本週中期逐漸影響華南沿岸。
星期一大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，局部地區有雷暴，日間短暫時間有陽光。氣溫介乎27至31度，相對濕度百分之70至95，吹東北風2至3級。
星期二天氣相若，大致多雲有幾陣驟雨，日間短暫有陽光。風勢初時微弱，其後轉東風3至4級，氣溫同樣27至31度。
星期三起天色好轉，有陽光及局部地區有驟雨，吹東風4級。星期四大致天晴，早晚間中多雲。星期五再轉大致多雲，有局部驟雨，日間有陽光。
天文台指熱帶氣旋杜鵑正橫過日本以南海域，預料不會直接影響香港。市民宜留意最新天氣報告，驟雨可能較為局部。
